text: This report focuses on the primary activities and achievements of the Education Branch at the Toronto Zoo for the year 2017. Education oversees a wide variety of different programs throughout the year that support key components of the Strategic Plan and further educational goals. These include school program offerings and teacher resources, as well as a roster of public programs for a variety of audiences/ages and summer camps. Overall program participation and revenues in 2017 were significantly affected by the labour disruption, with revenue down 22.1 percent, generating $807,618, and participation down by 26.1 percent over the preceding year. Bookings for fee-based school programs decreased by 30.8 percent over 2016, also a direct result of the labour disruption.
